frame.axes: right-handed metres: +x right, +y forward (the facing), +z up; origin = cell pivot on the ground
frame.rot: unit quaternion [x,y,z,w], local to the parent bone
frame.rotEuler: the same rotation in degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X
frame.pos: metres, local to the parent bone
frame.bind: every bind frame is identity; bind.pos is the joint in the figure frame
frame.u: k/frames, or k/(frames-1) on settle clips
frame.face: one group per slot switched on per frame: eyes.<state>, brows.<state>, mouth.<state>. The engine may replace the eyes state with the blink (faceClips.blink) and eyes.open with eyes.left / eyes.right (look)
frame.rock: deck rock is a live hull transform (camera roll/pitch); the counter-lean is the rock table, pre-multiplied onto spine, chest and head

shading.cull: back faces (toward-camera component of the flat normal <= 0)
shading.step: clamp(round(s*gain + bias + b), lo, hi) + off, clamped to the ramp; s = n.key + form*(n.toward - formMid). lo..hi is four tones: shadow, base, light, highlight; the contour pass may take one below
shading.headSnap: the head bone is moved in screen space so its centre sits on a pixel centre (<= 0.5 px)

faceClips.name: blink
faceClips.then: the eyes state of the clip frame that is showing
faceClips.firstBlink: uniform in [0, a first interval drawn from interval_ms]

look.sense: yaw > 0 turns the face toward the figure's +x (its right); pitch > 0 tips it down (the rig's pitch: the top toward +y)
look.compose: neck.local = clip.neck.local * E(split.neck * yaw, split.neck * pitch); head.local = rock.head * clip.head.local * E(split.head * yaw, split.head * pitch); E(y, p) = Rz(-y) * Rx(-p), angles in degrees, both clamped to the limits first
look.aim: on the frame as the clip poses it (unrocked, no turn): d = the target minus the head point (head bone * headMid), f = the head bone's +y, both in the chest frame; need.yaw = atan2(d.x, d.y) - atan2(f.x, f.y) (wrapped to -180..180), need.pitch = -atan2(d.z, |d.xy|) + atan2(f.z, |f.xy|); turn = clamp(headShare * need) per axis

eyes.rule: eyes.right when need.yaw - turn.yaw > beyond_deg, eyes.left when < -beyond_deg, else eyes.open; only in place of eyes.open (half, shut and wide stay as the clip has them); vertical gaze is the head pitch

sockets.purpose: left palm, same attitude as tool_R while a tool is held (the dig shaft runs left palm to right palm)
right palm. Rod, spade, knife, gaff: +y runs along the tool (RodIso's rod-local frame), pitched then turned as the clip's tool track says
rod bend, chord 1 — 0.40 of the tier length
rod bend, chord 2 — 0.70 of the tier length
left pail handle / oar loom / wheel rim — left palm, swung about local x by the pendulum
right pail handle / oar loom / wheel rim
tray, pot or wheel centre — midpoint of the palms, chest-parented, swung about local x
slung rod (back mount) — fixed on the chest

mounts.rod: tool_R (+ tool_R_1, tool_R_2 for the bend); off hand on tool_L
mounts.shovel: tool_R + tool_L, the shaft between the palms
mounts.warp: none — draw the rope through handL / handR / sheave pins
mounts.bench: none — the item pin is in the gameplay sidecar
mounts.rest: tool_R until the release, then nothing
mounts.free: carry_L / carry_R / carry_mid per the carry stance
mounts.wheel: carry pins unused; wheel grips in the sidecar
